js_only_note: toNative: the Python counterpart is Value.to_python(), a method because the Python Value is a class; the JS Value is a plain object embind builds, so the conversion is a module function.
native_only_note: Present in the native package and in Python; absent only from the WASM package.
value_tables: Each constant table on Formulon is, in Python, the module-level enum of the same name; ErrorDisplayName is ErrorCode.display_name.
